bio: Spoil yourself to a sumptuous Afternoon Tea at the boutique Taplow House. Enjoy a selection of sweet and savoury treats at this charming Georgian country hotel.  Afternoon Tea can be served in Berry's Restaurant, Berry's Bar or on Berry's Terrace if the weather is permitting. The hotel is set in six acres of picturesque gardens, and provides guests with the ideal opportunity to relax and indulge in the great British tradition in a grand, quintessentially British setting.  Their traditional Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of finger sandwiches served on white and wholemeal bread along with homemade scones. Diners can enjoy their meal with a choice of Newby loose leaf teas or Cafe du Monde cafetiere coffee. If you are feeling extra decadent, you can upgrade to include a chilled glass of Champagne.  This elegant country house is located on the border between Berkshire and Buckinghamshire, 40 minutes from central London and 10 minutes from Windsor.
